title: Thunderbird Show Park
specs: Hosts ten weeks of globally recognized hunter and jumper tournaments per year
First competition for young junior amateurs
Hosts world’s top athletes and horses in major FEI Grand Prix competitions
Offers world class show jumping, restaurants, bars, boutique shops, face painting and pony rides
blurb: Thunderbird Show Park hosts ten weeks of globally recognized hunter and jumper tournaments per year. It offers competitions for young junior amateurs to world-class FEI Grand Prix events. Spectators can enjoy show jumping, restaurants, bars, boutique shops, face painting, and pony rides at main events.
